title: hypericum maculatum subsp. undulatum
intro: Hypericum maculatum subsp. undulatum, commonly known as spotted St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort genus, characterized by its distinctive spotted leaves and yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce anxiety and stress, and protect against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate neurotransmitter activity and exert anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum maculatum subsp. undulatum make it a popular natural remedy for various health concerns, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions.
